'''Ivor Drake''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] politician from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kestos Minor/Legends|Kestos Minor]] who represented the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of the Delegation of 2000, Drake was among the senators who openly opposed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] consolidation of power and co-signed the [[Petition of 2000]] during the last days of the Republic. Shortly after attending the funeral of Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], she was arrested by the newly formed [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] on charges of conspiracy and treason.

==Biography==
A native of [[Kestos Minor/Legends|Kestos Minor]], Ivor Drake rose to political prominence as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]]. Throughout her career, she was regarded as a principled defender of liberty and a vocal critic of authoritarianism. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] consumed the galaxy, Drake became increasingly wary of the unchecked powers granted to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she allied herself with like-minded senators—including [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]]—who formed the [[Delegation of 2000]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> This group drafted and presented the [[Petition of 2000]], a formal request urging the Chancellor to relinquish his emergency powers and restore democratic rule.<ref name="SWI85" />

The [[Standard month/Legends|following months]] brought the collapse of the Republic and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After Palpatine declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|reorganized the Senate into a largely ceremonial body]], Drake remained defiant. She traveled to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to honor her late colleague and friend [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], joining other senators in the somber funeral procession through the streets of Theed.<ref name="db" /><ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> However, her open association with the Delegation of 2000 marked her as an enemy of the new regime. Shortly after Amidala’s funeral, Drake was arrested along with sixty&mdash;two other senators—including [[Tanner Cadaman/Legends|Tanner Cadaman]], [[Shea Sadashassa/Legends|Shea Sadashassa]], [[Streamdrinker/Legends|Streamdrinker]], [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], and [[Grebleips/Legends|Grebleips]]&mdash;by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the newly formed [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] on charges of conspiracy and treason, accused of supporting the so-called [[Showdown on Coruscant|Jedi Rebellion]].<ref name="SWI84">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref><ref name="TCSWE"/>

==Personality==
Ivor Drake was known as principled, steadfast, and deeply committed to the ideals of the Republic. She placed loyalty to democracy and justice above personal safety, refusing to remain silent in the face of tyranny. Despite the danger of opposing Palpatine, Drake’s decision to join the Delegation of 2000 reflected her courage and willingness to act on her convictions. To her colleagues, she was respected as both compassionate and unyielding, a senator who stood firmly for the people she represented.<ref name="SWI85" /><ref name="TCSWE"/>
